public.title: Map each product to its name
public.prompt: Each product should become its name. Which method returns a new list of the same length?

hints.text: forEach runs a function for each item but returns nothing.
The method you want builds a new list from each item's result.

explanations.workedExample: map calls a function on every item and collects the results into a new array of the same length. Here each product turns into its name.
explanations.practice: Write prices(products) that returns the price of each product using map.

secret.narration: map takes each item, runs your function on it, and collects the results. The list keeps its length, so every product gets exactly one label.

public.title: Keep only the items in stock
public.prompt: Now keep only the products whose stock is above zero. Which method keeps some items and drops the rest?

hints.text: The result can be shorter than the input, so map is not the answer.
The method that keeps an item when its test returns true.

explanations.workedExample: filter keeps each item whose test returns true. Products with no stock fail the test and drop out of the new list.
explanations.practice: Write onSale(products) that keeps items where p.sale is true.

secret.narration: filter also builds a new list, but it keeps only the items that pass the test. The input list is left as it was.
